entry.title: Share a game of peekaboo
entry.invitation: Share the surprise of peekaboo, then pause for their reply.
entry.summary: Play a little peekaboo together, leaving time for your baby’s look, sound, or gesture in reply.
entry.cue: Your baby is interested when someone disappears briefly and comes back.
detail: The authors include peekaboo among the games in their 9–12-month language section. Enjoy the back-and-forth and follow the response your baby gives.
A look, a movement, or a sound can be part of the exchange. There is no word your baby has to say to take part.

references.section: Language activities / 9 to 12 months; Observing the development of language

ageContext.note: The book’s ages are guides; this belongs here only while the described interest and movement fit your child.

displayContext.footer: You don’t need a different home. Start with what you have.
displayContext.colophon: Original summaries inspired by The Montessori Baby and The Montessori Toddler. Open any idea for its book references. The illustration is an invitation to explore, rather than a room to reproduce. Follow your child’s pace.
